{{Top|leg}}
'''Farmers' Landing''' was located at [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]. It was used by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] to dock their [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and barges at and unload [[vohis mold]] for sale to [[Brack]].
